profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Northwestern Mutual | Master of Science in Computer Science
profile.summary: With over six years of experience as a software developer, I am passionate about creating innovative and impactful healthcare software solutions. Currently, I work as a Software Developer II at Epic, where I design, develop, and test software features and enhancements for various healthcare applications, such as electronic health records, patient portals, and telemedicine. I collaborate with cross-functional teams of developers, analysts, testers, and clients to deliver high-quality products that meet the needs and expectations of end-users. I also leverage my skills in programming languages, such as C#, Java, and Python, and technical design tools, such as UML and agile methodologies, to ensure the software is reliable, scalable, and secure. Previously, I worked as a Software Developer at Epic, where I contributed to several projects, such as developing a web-based dashboard for monitoring and reporting on patient outcomes, integrating a third-party API for sending and receiving secure messages, and optimizing the performance and usability of the software. Additionally, I have a Master of Science degree in Computer Engineering from Texas A&M University, where I conducted research on machine learning and computer vision, and published multiple papers in peer-reviewed journals. I am driven by the mission of improving the quality and accessibility of healthcare through technology, and I am eager to learn new skills and technologies that can enhance my expertise and contributions to the field.

projects.description: Online service that allows pilots to bid more efficiently on the lines offered by their company. With Bid Buddy, pilots can search, sort, reorder and select the lines according to their preferences.

projects.title: Campus Connect
projects.description: Smartphone application allowing students and faculty to receive updates and important information directly from the police. In addition, Campus Connect allows users to send reports, which can include images, sound recordings and a location to police.
